title: Sheep dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="32" ry="6" fill="#2a1f4a"/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x="34" y="70" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <rect x="56" y="70" width="8" height="16" rx="3" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <!-- hooves back -->
  <rect x="33" y="83" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#1e1e3a"/>
  <rect x="55" y="83" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#1e1e3a"/>
  <!-- body fluff -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="22" fill="#f0f0f5"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="45" r="12" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="45" r="12" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="10" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="10" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- body shading patches -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="8" fill="#e0e0ea"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="7" fill="#e0e0ea"/>
  <!-- front legs (dancing, one up) -->
  <rect x="38" y="66" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#40405f"/>
  <rect x="54" y="60" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#40405f" transform="rotate(-20 58 67)"/>
  <rect x="37" y="78" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#22224a"/>
  <rect x="52" y="70" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#22224a" transform="rotate(-20 57 72)"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="26" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#f0f0f5" transform="rotate(-25 35 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="26" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#f0f0f5" transform="rotate(25 65 26)"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#f5d6c6"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="28" r="2.2" fill="#1a1a30"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="28" r="2.2" fill="#1a1a30"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="33" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#d4a08a"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46 36 Q50 40 54 36" stroke="#d4a08a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- music notes for dancing vibe -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="28" r="3" fill="#ffcc44"/>
  <rect x="77.5" y="16" width="1.8" height="12" fill="#ffcc44"/>
  <path d="M79.3 16 Q84 17 82 22" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#ff8844"/>
  <rect x="25.2" y="32" width="1.5" height="10" fill="#ff8844"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#88ddff"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="46" r="1.5" fill="#88ddff"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="58" r="1.2" fill="#88ddff"/>
</svg>
